correctness.rationale: A full proof identifies all derivations as inner, reduces operator idempotence to exactly two idempotent generators, proves unipotent conjugacy of each fixed-diagonal fiber and its q^cut cardinality, then derives the entire rank polynomial. The maximum tripartite cut has 6(2^n-1) binary colorings. The entropy/compactness bound at eta=1/100 proves exponential maximal-rank concentration for every fixed q. Standalone exhaustive small cases and n<=10 cut maximum checks ended VERIFY_OK; computation is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full rank distribution of concrete idempotent derivation operators is a natural restricted-nilpotent/graded-algebra invariant, distinct from grading isomorphism-class counts. It links an infinite family of noncommutative incidence algebras to weighted complete tripartite cuts, determines all rank multiplicities and gives exact exponentially degenerate maximal strata with concentration. This is a substantive infinite-family classification with quantitative new structure, not a tiny special-case computation.
